container.title: Container Image
container.description: simpleaf container image (bundles simpleaf, alevin-fry, piscem, and salmon). The default matches the simpleaf that nf-core/scrnaseq 4.2.0 quantifies with; a piscem from a different major version writes an index layout that pipeline cannot read.

simpleaf_extra_args.title: Extra Arguments
simpleaf_extra_args.description: Additional arguments to pass to simpleaf index (e.g. --use-salmon to index with salmon instead of piscem).
